title: Diagnostics
subtitle: Deterministic analytics findings for this business
noFindings: No findings for the selected filters.
noFindingsBody: Adjust the filters or choose another period.
noCampaignStates: No campaign data for this period.
funnelBottleneckBody: Largest drop-off between observed funnel stages.

low_ctr.title: Click-through rate below 0.7%
low_ctr.description: The campaign is getting impressions but relatively few clicks. Review ad relevance, targeting and creative.

ctr_decline.title: CTR declined vs previous period
ctr_decline.description: Click-through rate dropped by 30% or more compared with the previous period.

high_cpc.title: Cost per click above 10.00
high_cpc.description: The average click cost exceeds the baseline, reducing the number of clicks per dollar spent.

high_cpm.title: Cost per mille above 800.00
high_cpm.description: For every thousand impressions the ad costs more than the baseline.

creative_low_ctr.title: Creative CTR below 0.7%
creative_low_ctr.description: This creative under-performs on engagement; consider testing new angles.

possible_creative_fatigue.title: Possible creative fatigue
possible_creative_fatigue.description: High frequency combined with a CTR decline while spend is active — a fatigue signal, not a certainty.

low_cvr.title: Conversion rate below 3%
low_cvr.description: Clicks are not converting into purchases at the expected rate.

cvr_decline.title: CVR declined vs previous period
cvr_decline.description: The purchase conversion rate dropped by 30% or more compared with the previous period.

high_cpa.title: Cost per acquisition above target
high_cpa.description: The purchase cost is above the business goal or break-even CPA.

below_break_even_roas.title: ROAS below break-even
below_break_even_roas.description: Revenue attributed to ads is below the unit-economics break-even ROAS, meaning the activity is not profitable.

below_target_roas.title: ROAS below target
below_target_roas.description: Revenue per ad spend is below the target set in the business goal.

negative_contribution_profit.title: Negative contribution profit
negative_contribution_profit.description: Average unit economics produce a negative contribution profit per sale.

declining_contribution_margin.title: Margin declined vs previous period
declining_contribution_margin.description: The average contribution margin dropped by 15% or more while revenue grew.

revenue_profit_divergence.title: Revenue growth with profit decline
revenue_profit_divergence.description: Revenue grew at least 20% while contribution profit fell at least 15% — growth is not profitable.

negative_unit_margin.title: Negative unit margin
negative_unit_margin.description: At least one product sells below contribution break-even.

break_even_unavailable.title: Break-even not available
break_even_unavailable.description: Purchases exist but unit economics do not — profitability cannot be assessed.

target_cpa_above_viable.title: CPA target above viable level
target_cpa_above_viable.description: The goal CPA exceeds the break-even CPA for the business.

funnel_bottleneck.title: Funnel bottleneck detected
funnel_bottleneck.description: A stage transition converts below 5% of the previous stage, the largest observed drop-off.

low_click_to_purchase_rate.title: Low click-to-purchase rate
low_click_to_purchase_rate.description: Intermediate funnel stages are unavailable; purchases are low compared with clicks.

spend_without_purchase.title: Spend without purchases
spend_without_purchase.description: Spend exceeds 100.00 with no purchases in the period.

purchase_revenue_mismatch.title: Purchases without revenue
purchase_revenue_mismatch.description: Commerce orders exist but no revenue is recorded.

revenue_purchase_mismatch.title: Revenue without purchases
revenue_purchase_mismatch.description: Revenue is recorded but no purchases are counted.

provider_conversion_mismatch.title: Provider conversions vs purchases
provider_conversion_mismatch.description: Meta-reported conversions differ from commerce purchases by 50% or more.

stale_meta_data.title: Meta data is stale
stale_meta_data.description: The last Meta sync is older than the freshness window.

stale_shopify_data.title: Shopify data is stale
stale_shopify_data.description: The last Shopify sync is older than the freshness window.

delayed_meta_data.title: Meta data is delayed
delayed_meta_data.description: The last Meta sync is delayed; figures may be incomplete.

delayed_shopify_data.title: Shopify data is delayed
delayed_shopify_data.description: The last Shopify sync is delayed; figures may be incomplete.

meta_not_connected.title: Meta is not connected
meta_not_connected.description: No connected Meta Ads account; ad metrics are not available.

shopify_not_connected.title: Shopify is not connected
shopify_not_connected.description: No connected Shopify store; commerce metrics are not available.

missing_meta_reporting_period.title: Meta reporting period missing
missing_meta_reporting_period.description: No Meta fact table covers the requested period.

missing_shopify_reporting_period.title: Shopify reporting period missing
missing_shopify_reporting_period.description: No Shopify fact table covers the requested period.

incomplete_reporting_period.title: Incomplete reporting period
incomplete_reporting_period.description: Two or more days are missing from the requested range.

unobserved_funnel_stages.title: Funnel stages not observed
unobserved_funnel_stages.description: Product, cart and checkout stages are not reported by the connected providers.

recent_sync_failures.title: Recent sync failures
recent_sync_failures.description: A provider sync failed within the last 24 hours.

persistent_unprofitable_performance.title: Persistently unprofitable
persistent_unprofitable_performance.description: Performance stayed below break-even across consecutive periods; review is recommended.
